patch_description: Instead of the previous program's full 286-triangle rescore every iteration, this version exploits the key geometric insight: moving a single point only changes the 66 triangles containing it. It maintains a cached full area vector and updates only the affected entries on acceptance, recomputing hull area only when a hull vertex moves (else cached). This ~5x per-iteration speedup is converted into many more local-search trials per restart. The search is a deterministic greedy bottleneck descent: identify the minimal triangle, move its vertices (or a random point) with shrinking steps, accept strict improvements in min_area/hull_area. Multiple structured restarts (13-gon ring, ring+center, two-ring, jittered disk) each get a share of the time budget, followed by fine polish. Fixed seeds guarantee reproducibility.
